MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 164, January 17, 1969 ]
CREATING A COMMITTEE TO COORDINATE AND SUPERVISE THE COLLATION, COLLECTION,
IDENTIFICATION, CLASSIFICATION, REPRODUCTION AND RELEASE OF ARCHIVAL
MATERIALS AND OTHER HISTORICAL PAPERS IN THE POSSESSION OF GOVERNMENT
WHEREAS, archival materials or historical documents constitute the collective memory of the Filipino
WHEREAS, many of such materials affect and concern the security, dignity and welfare of the Filipino
WHEREAS, appropriate measures of conservation and protection are essential in order to prevent
suppression, alteration and distortion of said documents, or their use in any manner contrary to the national
interests; and
WHEREAS, to achieve this end an all-Filipino group composed of distinguished representatives of the
historical sciences would be best fitted to coordinate and supervise the collation, collection, identification,
classification, reproduction and release of historical documents and archival materials.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create a Historical Documents Committee composed of the following:
Secretary of Education
......................
Director of the Bureau of Records Management
......................
Chairman of the National Historical Commission
......................
President of the Philippine Historical Association
......................
President of the Philippine Historical Society
......................
President of the International Association of Historian in Asia
......................
Director of the National Library
......................
Director of the Asian Center , University of the Philippines
......................
Chairman of the Department of History, College of Arts and Sciences, University of the Philippines
......................
Father Horacio de la Costa, in representation of the Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines
......................
Dr. Sotero P. Laurel, in representation of the Philippine Association of Colleges and Universities
......................
Dr. Arturo Guerrero, in representation of the Association of Christian Schools and Colleges
......................
This Committee shall undertake the following functions:
1. Supervise and coordinate all efforts of Government agencies in the collation, collection, identification,
reproduction and release of all historical documents;
2. Undertake collation, identification, and classification of documents relating to or affecting the security,
dignity and welfare of the Filipino nation and such other materials as are likely to affect the national interest
and to regulate access to, inspection, reproduction, and release of such documents.
